_comment: Written by the trading runs (9:30a / hourly / 3:30p ET). Never contains account numbers, broker IDs, or any account other than the sandbox.

account.note: PULLED LIVE AT 15:35 ET AGAINST THE MANDATED ACCOUNT BY THE PRE-CLOSE RUN, TWENTY-FIVE MINUTES BEFORE THE BELL. Portfolio, equity positions and option positions were each queried live and all three returned first time: 1009.16 total, 1009.16 cash, zero equity value, zero options value, zero pending deposits and ZERO unsettled, with buying_power reading 1009.16 to match. BOTH POSITION LISTS ARE EMPTY, which discharges the exit step rather than excusing it: no target, stop or time stop is reachable because no position carries one, and NO OPTION NO-FLY WINDOW IS REACHABLE because no contract is held. THE WHOLE BALANCE IS SETTLED, so the whole of it is deployable and no good-faith violation is reachable. THE 09:49 SMTC SPECIFICATION IS DEAD. It expired unexecuted on its 15:30 fuse - 2 shares at a 138.50 limit - and non-execution is established by the BROKER rather than by the empty position list: ZERO equity orders on a created_at floor of 2026-08-22. It is the fifteenth consecutive unexecuted entry on this board, and IT DIED MARKETABLE, which is the finding and is not softened. The 15:29 bar closed 137.860 and the 15:30 bar opened 137.870, so at the instant the fuse burned a BUY limit at 138.50 sat 0.63 ABOVE the tape and was immediately fillable at the offer. Inside that same 15:30 minute SMTC traded UP THROUGH the limit to a 138.680 high on 23,861 shares, the heaviest minute of the afternoon, and it has not come back: 138.46 bid / 138.71 ask at 19:35:15.248841502Z, last 138.640, +8.58% on the bid against a 127.520 close, on a 0.18% spread. THE LEVEL WAS AVAILABLE ALL AFTERNOON AND THE NAME LEFT THROUGH THE TOP OF IT AS THE CLOCK RAN OUT - a delivery failure and not a thesis failure, with all three pre-registered invalidations untripped at every one of the six hourly re-quotes and the operator notified at 12:21, 13:21, 14:21 and 15:21. THE SPECIFICATION IS NOT RE-STRUCK, IN EITHER DIRECTION: not carried at 138.50, because a spec that outlives its session is a standing instruction resting on a tape that no longer exists and would carry the position through the very NVDA print its own forced marking named as failure number two; and not lifted to 138.46 to catch where the name now is, which is the FUTU and BJ refusal and the one this board made against its own BZ entry this morning. NO NEW POSITION WAS OPENED. The daily entry mandate binds the open slot and explicitly not this one, and opening into a print with twenty-five minutes left would be acting in order to have acted. THE OVERNIGHT DECISION IS THAT THERE IS NOTHING TO HOLD, AND THAT IS A DECISION: the book goes into tonight's NVDA print FLAT, which is the outcome moves.json branch one committed to on 8/21, six sessions early, and it is now actual rather than anticipated. No straddle was pulled and none was owed - item 3 binds before an earnings hold, and there is no hold.

entryWatch.setup: SMTC post-earnings day 1 - reported 8/25 after the close, SPECIFIED at 09:49 at a 138.50 limit for 2 shares, FORCED on items 2 and 3, RE-QUOTED AND CONFIRMED six times, EXPIRED UNEXECUTED at 15:30
entryWatch.trigger: EXPIRED ON THE FUSE AT 15:30, AND IT DIED MARKETABLE - THE WORST SHAPE AVAILABLE AND THE ONE THAT IS NOT SOFTENED. Non-execution is established by the BROKER and not by the empty shelf: ZERO equity orders on the account on a created_at floor of 2026-08-22. At the instant of expiry SMTC was trading 137.87 - the 15:29 bar closed 137.860, the 15:30 bar opened 137.870 - so a BUY limit at 138.50 sat 0.63 ABOVE the tape and was immediately fillable at the offer. It was not a resting bid hoping for a give-back. An operator who pressed the button at 15:29:59 was filled. INSIDE THE SAME 15:30 MINUTE THE NAME TRADED UP THROUGH THE LIMIT to a 138.680 high on 23,861 shares, the heaviest minute of the afternoon, and it has not come back since: 138.470 at 15:32, a 138.570 high at 15:33, a 138.620 high at 15:34, and 138.46 bid / 138.71 ask at 19:35:15.248841502Z, last 138.640, +8.58% on the bid and +8.72% on the last, on a 0.18% spread. THE LIMIT IS NOW BELOW THE BID. This is the fifteenth consecutive unexecuted entry on this board and the first to die with its named level having traded at length, on volume, and in the closing minutes - a DELIVERY failure, not a thesis failure. Six hourly runs re-quoted it and confirmed it, all three pre-registered invalidations were tested mechanically at every one and not one ever tripped, the limit was refused downward at 136.50 and 135.56 and upward at 139.16, and the operator was notified at 12:21, 13:21, 14:21 and 15:21. IT IS NOT RE-STRUCK IN EITHER DIRECTION. Not carried at 138.50: a specification that outlives its session is a standing instruction resting on a tape that no longer exists, and this one would carry the position straight through tonight's NVDA print - the exact event its own forced marking named as failure number two. Not lifted to 138.46 to catch where the name actually is: that is re-striking a dead level higher, which is the FUTU 117.90 refusal, the BJ 97.35 refusal made twice, and the refusal this board made this morning against its own BZ entry. Widening the time is not permission to widen the price. Tomorrow's open writes tomorrow's entry on tomorrow's quotes, with NVDA's number known.
entryWatch.why: The 09:49 entry was FORCED on items 2 and 3 and clean on the other four, and every one of those markings stands as struck. Item 1 was a 24.6% beat, Q2 EPS 0.71 against 0.57 on a live calendar pull. Item 5 was the strongest reading on the board: SMTC marked DOWN 21.6% into its own print, 154.22 on 8/17 to a 120.91 close on 8/24, on 8,904,562 shares on 8/25 against a ~2.3M average. Item 4 passed on a 0.17% spread. Item 2 failed outright at +13.90% with the whole board green alongside it, and item 3 failed because NVDA reports tonight, inside the five-session window. The forced marking was never revised by a later tape in either direction - the item 2 reading crossed the +8% line four times across six hours, from +13.47% down to +7.97% and back - because a marking struck at publication is not re-graded by the market moving. What killed this entry was not any of that. It was the clock.

entryWatch.setup: BZ post-earnings day 2 - the 8/25 specification at 15.95 expired unexecuted and is NOT re-struck
entryWatch.trigger: REFUSED TODAY ON THIS BOARD'S OWN MOST-REFUSED BEHAVIOUR, AND IT READS DIFFERENTLY NOW THAT THE SMTC ENTRY HAS DIED THE SAME DEATH. BZ was 18.73 bid / 18.77 ask at 2026-08-26T13:53:00.508516304Z, last 18.760, +15.16% against the 16.290 close, on a 0.21% spread. Yesterday's thesis was RIGHT and delivery is what failed: a fill at 15.95 would be +2.81 a share, +17.6%. That did not make BZ buyable at 18.73, because buying it there is re-striking a dead 15.95 limit 17.4% higher to chase a name that got away - the FUTU 117.90 and BJ 97.35 refusal applied to this board's own entry, which is the harder version and the one that counts. TWO CONSECUTIVE SESSIONS HAVE NOW ENDED WITH A CORRECT THESIS AND NO POSITION, which is the pattern the record should be read on rather than either day alone.
entryWatch.why: The 8/25 entry was FORCED on item 2, confirmed six times by the hourly runs with all three pre-registered invalidations tested at each and none ever tripped, and it died on its 15:30 fuse with the closing bid 16.225 against the 15.95 limit - the fourteenth consecutive unexecuted entry. It was not carried overnight because a specification that outlives its session is a standing instruction resting on a tape that no longer exists. Today's tape vindicated the reasoning and changed nothing about the rule: the level is dead, and a dead level does not come back to life because the name went up. The identical judgement is applied to SMTC one row above, one day later, on a name that closed ABOVE its limit rather than below it.

candidatesNote: Re-quoted at 15:35 ET on 8/26 by the pre-close run for the names carrying a live decision - SMTC, whose specification expired at 15:30, and the semiconductor complex that tonight's print runs through. The other rows still carry their 09:52-09:53 open-run quotes and are labelled as of that time in their own notes; they were not re-pulled because no decision at this hour rests on them. THE ONE-LINE READ: the 09:49 SMTC specification EXPIRED UNEXECUTED AT 15:30 AND DIED MARKETABLE, with the tape at 137.87 and the limit 0.63 above it, then traded UP THROUGH 138.50 to a 138.680 high inside that same minute on the heaviest volume of the afternoon and is 138.46 bid now - the fifteenth consecutive unexecuted entry and a delivery failure rather than a thesis failure, NOT re-struck in either direction. The book is FLAT into tonight's NVDA print at 210.60 bid, -1.15%, which is the outcome branch one committed to on 8/21.

candidates.note: RE-QUOTED AT 15:35 BY THE PRE-CLOSE RUN, AFTER ITS SPECIFICATION HAD ALREADY EXPIRED: 138.46 bid / 138.71 ask at 19:35:15.248841502Z, last 138.640, +8.58% on the bid and +8.72% on the last against a 127.520 close, on a 0.18% spread. THE 09:49 SPECIFICATION - 2 shares at a 138.50 limit, FORCED on items 2 and 3, CONFIRMED SIX TIMES - EXPIRED UNEXECUTED ON ITS 15:30 FUSE, established by the broker's ZERO equity orders since 8/22 rather than by the empty position list. IT DIED MARKETABLE: the 15:29 bar closed 137.860 and the 15:30 bar opened 137.870, so the limit sat 0.63 ABOVE the tape and was fillable at the offer at the moment the clock ran out, and inside that same 15:30 minute the name traded through it to a 138.680 high on 23,861 shares - the heaviest minute of the afternoon - and has held above the limit since. The limit is now UNDER the bid. Fifteenth consecutive unexecuted entry, a DELIVERY failure rather than a thesis failure, and NOT RE-STRUCK: not carried at 138.50 into tonight's NVDA print, which is the event item 3 failed on this morning, and not lifted to 138.46 to chase, which is the FUTU, BJ and BZ refusal. The thesis is unchanged and was not re-argued: Q2 EPS 0.710 against 0.570, a 24.6% beat, on a name marked DOWN 21.6% into its own print. Tomorrow's open owns whether there is a day-2 entry here, on tomorrow's quotes and with NVDA's number known.

139.76 bid / 140.40 ask at 13:53:01.472625787Z, last 140.085, +28.64% against a 108.900 close on a 0.46% spread. THE STRONGEST TAPE ON THE BOARD AND REFUSED ON NUMBERS OVER NARRATIVE. It gapped, ran to 141.92, gave back 3.7% to 136.59 and rebuilt to the highs - a genuine intraday pullback-and-reclaim, the healthiest structure here. The refusal is that a 2.42 against 2.37 EPS beat, up 2.1%, cannot be reconciled with a 28.6% move from any number this run pulled: the driver is guidance or comps I cannot see, so buying it means buying a story rather than an arithmetic. It is also a new three-month high, well above the 119.92 high of 8/11, so item 5 reads the wrong way - this is not a name recovering from a markdown, it is one being re-rated into clear air.

18.73 bid / 18.77 ask at 13:53:00.508516304Z, last 18.760, +15.16% against a 16.290 close on a 0.21% spread. Day 2 of the print this board specified yesterday at 15.95, and REFUSED because buying it now is re-striking a dead limit 17.4% higher - the FUTU and BJ refusal applied to this board's own entry. Yesterday's reasoning was right: a fill at 15.95 would be +17.6% now. Delivery failed, not the thesis, and the rule that follows is that widening the time is not permission to widen the price.

130.49 bid / 130.89 ask at 13:52:58.538298541Z, last 130.730, +4.05% against a 125.450 close on a 0.31% spread. Q1 3.24 against 2.22, a 45.9% beat - the largest on the board that the tape did not reject - and the only large-beat name that passes item 2 literally. REFUSED ON ITEM 5: it went INTO the print at the top of a month-long grind, 117.50 on 8/3 to a 125.87 close on 8/24, so expectations were raised into this report rather than cut. The WMT arithmetic applies on top: +20% is 156.88 inside five sessions, which a staples name does not produce, so the exits would be decoration. Faded from a 134.85 open to 130.49, which is the tape agreeing.

30.53 bid / 30.73 ask at 13:53:01.316029278Z, last 30.590, +4.13% against a 29.320 close on a 0.65% spread. A 25% beat (0.50 against 0.40) and THE CLEAREST DISTRIBUTION DAY ON THE BOARD: it opened 37.48, printed 37.91, and has fallen 19.3% from that high with no floor established - a fresh low at 09:41 and lower again by 09:53. Buying it is catching a knife on print day, and it carries the same NVDA event gap as every other semi-cap name into tonight.

16.51 bid / 16.55 ask at 13:52:58.304121771Z, last 16.530, -6.50% against a 17.680 close on a 0.24% spread. EPS 1.28 against 0.55, a 133% beat, AND THE STOCK IS DOWN - it spiked to 17.77 in the second minute and was sold to 16.02. This is item 5 firing the other way: the beat was not the story and the tape said so within two minutes. A beat the market rejects is not a catalyst, it is a warning.

17.56 bid / 17.61 ask at 13:53:03.19769886Z, last 17.5805, +0.00% against a 17.580 close on a 0.28% spread. EPS 0.62 against 0.21, a 195% beat, and the stock is EXACTLY unchanged. Looked at as a sympathy laggard against ANF's +28.6% in the same complex and refused: it is not a name that has not been looked at, it is a name that was looked at and priced. The tape confirms it - opened 18.26, printed 18.73, and bled all morning to 17.43. Not moving would be one thing; going down on a 195% beat is another.

344.23 bid / 344.65 ask at 13:53:01.68357106Z, last 344.430, -3.65% against a 357.460 close on a 0.12% spread. EPS 4.03 against 3.29, a 22.5% beat, and it is DOWN 3.65% and making session lows - crowded bulls into a print meeting a merely-good report, which is item 5 in the textbook shape. One share is also 34.1% of the account, so a two-share position is impossible inside the 40% ceiling regardless of the view.

94.39 bid / 94.43 ask at 13:53:03.204780357Z, last 94.420, +1.42% against a 93.100 close on a 0.04% spread - the tightest quote on this board. Day 2, a genuine grinding continuation off a 7.8% beat, and THE ONLY NAME HERE THAT PASSES ITEM 2 BOTH LITERALLY AND IN SPIRIT. Refused twice over: the WMT arithmetic (+20% is 113.27 on a Canadian bank inside five sessions, which is not a number it produces) and consistency - this board refused BNS in writing yesterday at 89.52 and it is 5.4% higher today, so re-entering is the same dead-level-higher error being refused at BZ.
